candidate_change: Make change-impact delivery mandatory and explicit; no professional module changes
conditions: Fresh subagents, same inherited model/configuration and tool surface, identical raw tasks, separate outputs, one run per variant, no rubric or expected answer in execution context
acceptance: Candidate must meet every H01–H03 criterion in an independent output review and introduce no new unauthorized work; baseline comparison is descriptive because n=1 per variant
telemetry_boundary: Record model/runtime/cost only if exposed; do not infer unavailable values
